paragraphs.text: The prophet shows that the time will come, that all nations will have opportunity to praise the Lord for the revealing of his gospel.
paragraphs.label: a
paragraphs.anchor: unto the LORD a new song

paragraphs.text: Seeing he will reveal himself to all nations contrary to their own expectation, they should all worship him contrary to their own imaginations, and only as he has appointed.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: Then the idols or whatever did not make the heavens, are not God.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: God cannot be known but by his strength and glory, the signs of which appear in his sanctuary.
paragraphs.label: d
paragraphs.anchor: Honour and majesty are before him

paragraphs.text: As by experience you see that it is only due to him.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: By offering up yourselves wholly to God, declare that you worship him only.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: He prophecies that the Gentiles will be partakers with the Jews of God's promise.
paragraphs.label: g

paragraphs.text: He will regenerate them anew with his Spirit, and restore them to the image of God.
paragraphs.label: h

paragraphs.text: If the insensible creatures will have reason to rejoice when God appears, much more we, from whom he has taken malediction and sin.
paragraphs.label: i
